periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping outwards at the superior margin.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid geometry with a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the muzzle, creating a teardrop-like extension below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape profile at the posterior margin of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, covering approximately 40% of the visible upper torso span at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation distance, roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High smoothness with a predominantly circular curvature at the apex.
